verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a state tax authority whose filing, payment and open-data services operate under a single government jurisdiction. Letting taxpayers pick a storage region is a cloud/SaaS capability, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any residency or region selection that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
